The post-merge Pages deployment for #134 / PR #135 did not publish the new mute and volume controls. The `checks / browser` job exceeded its existing 10-minute limit, the workflow concluded `cancelled`, and `deploy` was skipped. Core checks passed. This is a deployment/validation failure; no browser test failure or final passing suite total was reported before cancellation.

## Expected outcome

Publish the merged implementation and complete the required live verification without weakening applicable browser coverage or bypassing checks.

## Context and reproduction

- Related: #7, #134, #135.
- Merge commit: `b22d34d8126bfc6aee12c91c0ca9cc2bce3b32a8` (reviewed PR head: `54b031be3a7dcf2317c61ba44d14ecd462666ec1`).
- Failed deployment run: https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/actions/runs/41416164519
- Browser job/logs: https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/actions/runs/41416164519/job/125180416896
- Job annotation: `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 10m0s`.
- Final log error at 2026-11-02 09:02:17 UTC: `The operation was canceled.` The Playwright step was still serving test assets immediately beforehand.
- Public URL: https://takahirox.github.io/snes-rust/

After the failed run, real Chromium checks at desktop 1280×900, portrait 320×740 and landscape 667×320 all reached Ready but still showed the old Sound checkbox, with no `#mute` button or `#volume` slider. The published HTML/JS/CSS differed from the reviewed sources. These initial-load checks had no console/page errors or HTTP failures; they do not validate the unpublished audio changes.

Reproduce by inspecting the run above and opening the public URL in a fresh browser context. Expected: one always-visible mute button plus volume slider. Actual: previous Sound checkbox. Required new-version live mute/attenuation checks therefore remain pending. The pre-merge PR core and browser run passed: https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/actions/runs/41415029694

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Diagnose the timeout using actual step/test timing; distinguish runner variability from a repeatable regression.
- [ ] Apply the smallest justified fix, if needed, retaining the applicable production build, full browser suite, provenance/asset checks and required gates. Report the measured result and any unperformed checks honestly.

## Optional validation

Physical iOS Safari / Android Chrome and headphone listening remain optional.

## Required post-merge verification

- [ ] Record a successful main Pages deployment run that includes the merged volume controls.
- [ ] On the actual public app at desktop, narrow portrait and short landscape sizes, verify the always-visible controls, working mute/restore, smooth live output attenuation and no page errors; record screenshots and measured browser audio evidence.
- [ ] Verify the deployed assets correspond to the intended revision. Do not count checks of the previous published app as completion.

This follow-up records the failed post-merge verification; #134 remains closed by the implementation merge.
